args.prompt: First half of one continuous cinematic sword-fight shot on a storm-soaked pirate deck, from canonical F01 exactly toward canonical F05. Preserve the exact two adult pirate identities, costumes, wet-hair structure, faces, body proportions, blades, ship geometry, lantern lighting and realistic game-cinematic/film-still rendering of the supplied anchors. The dark-haired swordsman on the left commits into the forward attack while the red-haired opponent on the right raises and shifts into the canonical midpoint defense. Arms, legs, hips, hands and blade trajectories evolve continuously and physically. Rain, spray, wet cloth, hair and background crew move independently. Land naturally on the supplied F05 composition. No cut, no camera discontinuity.
